newsitem.title: USA: Guyana president Jagan's health failing.
newsitem.headline: Guyana president Jagan's health failing.

text.p: Guyana's President Cheddi Jagan has taken a turn for the worse two weeks after heart surgery at Walter Reed Army Medical Centre, a spokesman for the hospital said on Tuesday.
"President Jagan is very seriously ill. He has taken a turn for the worse," spokesman Ben Smith said.
In Georgetown on Monday, Information Minister Moses Nagamootoo told Reuters that Jagan, 78, was failing.
"The president's heart's condition deteriorated this morning and his lungs are not working properly," he said, calling Jagan's condition "extremely critical."
Doctors performed a procedure called an angioplasty to clear blocked arteries after Jagan was flown from Georgetown on Feb. 15 suffering from heart pains.
